body: A wound around the right to assert yourself and act on your own behalf; you may freeze between aggression and apology.
business: Once owned, you teach others to claim their initiative without guilt.
shadow: Veering between meekness and overcorrected aggression.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
